scope: Only native fyg75a45/p883efur, original export j5_1lx0a, and the three explicitly listed generation/replay pairs. Later production-local-variable probes are excluded.

stages.name: c
stages.semantic: GBufferC t5 sampled red after SRGB SRV decode; surface.baseColor.r for production model ID 1.

stages.name: m
stages.semantic: Decoded metallic phi; equals GBufferB t4 sampled red for production model ID 1. Eye-model select %145 equals %119 for ID 1.

stages.name: r
stages.semantic: Effective roughness FMax(raw decoded %126, View CB0 register 275.w %768); exact counterpart of surface.roughness after minimum floor.

stages.name: NoL
stages.semantic: Area.NoL: Saturate(%793), where %793 includes original light-radius correction. Raw geometric dot is %775 and is not the requested area value.

stages.name: N_x
stages.semantic: Normalized UE normal x: original rsqrt(%139) times decoded normal x.

stages.name: N_y
stages.semantic: Normalized UE normal y: original rsqrt(%139) times decoded normal y.

stages.name: N_z
stages.semantic: Normalized UE normal z: original rsqrt(%139) times decoded normal z.

stages.name: V_x
stages.semantic: View x: original negative normalized interpolated TEXCOORD1 screen-vector x.

stages.name: V_y
stages.semantic: View y: original negative normalized interpolated TEXCOORD1 screen-vector y.

stages.name: V_z
stages.semantic: View z: original negative normalized interpolated TEXCOORD1 screen-vector z.

stages.name: Ndot
stages.semantic: Original dot3(decoded normal, decoded normal), before normalization. For ID 1 this corresponds to dot(surface.normalUE, surface.normalUE).

stages.name: Vdot
stages.semantic: Original dot3(interpolated TEXCOORD1.xyz screen vector, itself), before normalization.

stages.name: directDiffuse_r
stages.semantic: Original exposure-free Split.DiffuseLighting component, after diffuse scale, light color and surface shadow, plus scaled/colorized transmission under transmission shadow. For production ID 1 transmission is exactly zero, so this is the directDiffuse counterpart.

stages.name: directDiffuse_g
stages.semantic: Original exposure-free Split.DiffuseLighting component, after diffuse scale, light color and surface shadow, plus scaled/colorized transmission under transmission shadow. For production ID 1 transmission is exactly zero, so this is the directDiffuse counterpart.

stages.name: directDiffuse_b
stages.semantic: Original exposure-free Split.DiffuseLighting component, after diffuse scale, light color and surface shadow, plus scaled/colorized transmission under transmission shadow. For production ID 1 transmission is exactly zero, so this is the directDiffuse counterpart.

stages.name: diffuseColor_r
stages.semantic: Actual original decoded diffuse color red before View diffuse override: %184 - (%184 * %145). For ID 1, %184=%48=c and %145=%119=m. View diffuse override is identity in this capture. Preserve existing fast flags and contraction behavior.

diffuse_interpretation.limitation: Native diffuse_prefix calls ueComputeDiffuseColor again. Its equal samples do not establish production diffuseColor identity: precision propagation, contraction, reassociation and lowering may differ between evaluations. Original directDiffuse remains unchanged and differs at two points.
